column3: With respect to the Courtyard Amarillo Downtown Mortgage Loan (2.1%), Alan Rhodes, a principal of the borrower, was subject to an investigation by the Federal Bureau of Investigation into a sale of a building to the Amarillo Economic Development Corp., in which he was accused of using inside information. Mr. Rhodes has denied the allegation and has stated that the last activity in the investigation of which he was aware was in 2017.
